parameters.prompt: Compose an ORIGINAL instrumental cue for a sophisticated contemporary dark-romance interactive drama, adult mutual attraction, dangerous secrets, charismatic powerful male lead. Strong emotional tension and immediately recognizable rhythm, not generic ambient wallpaper. Clear on phone speakers through mid-bass harmonics, not only sub-bass. No vocals, words, breathing, choir, spoken samples or environmental effects. Original melody and arrangement, no quotations from existing recordings. Musical sections must visibly change in energy while leaving midrange space for dialogue. 40-second dramatic hybrid string and dark electronic cue at104 BPM, D minor with brief chromatic upper-neighbor tension. Precisely articulated repeating cello figure, insistent restrained kick, clipped low piano chord responses, ticking percussion and rising viola countermelody. 0-8s contained confrontation; 8-20s rhythmic layers accumulate and harmony tightens; 20s sudden beat of near silence for a decisive line; 21-33s forceful return with octave low strings and rhythmic displacement; 33-40s unresolved uneasy sustained chord with a short pulse underneath. Tension must evolve, not stay flat. No gunshots, horror shrieks, enormous trailer hits or constant cymbal wash.
